tools.name: arif_init
tools.description: Ignite or resume a governed session. Returns session_id and session_token required for subsequent operations. Modes: init (default new session), preflight (inspect existing session state), resume (continue active session), validate (re-check credentials), canary (transport probe), triage (read sessi

tools.name: arif_observe
tools.description: Sense reality into sourced evidence — gather external facts with provenance, the kernel's sensing verb. Run it before arif_think or arif_judge so decisions rest on sourced facts. Modes: search (web/literature query, default), fetch (one URL with provenance), hybrid_discovery (combine sources), inges

tools.name: arif_think
tools.description: Structured reasoning and plan formulation — decomposes a question or claim into labeled derivations (OBS/DER/INT) before you act. Modes: reason (inquiry breakdown, default), reflect (self-review of prior reasoning), verify (check a derivation), axioms (surface hidden assumptions), plan/plan_review/p

tools.name: arif_route
tools.description: Classify an intent and route it to the organ that owns it — GEOX (Earth science), WEALTH (capital markets), WELL (human vitality), A-FORGE (execution), or the arifOS kernel itself. Modes: route (default; classify and recommend), triage (rank a batch of intents), delegate (prepare an A2A handoff), st

tools.name: arif_memory
tools.description: Persistent institutional knowledge across sessions — store, recall, and curate lessons, decisions, and context so later sessions inherit them. Modes: recall (semantic search, default), inspect (read one memory in full), attest (vouch for its accuracy), remember (store a self-contained lesson), promo

tools.name: arif_judge
tools.description: Evaluate proposed operations against policy and safety constraints. Weighs blast radius, reversibility, and permission level. Returns binding verdict (SEAL for approved, HOLD for blocked, SABAR for awaiting conditions). Approval verdict is required prior to calling arif_forge. Outputs: evaluation ve

tools.name: arif_forge
tools.description: Execute an action arif_judge has already SEALed — nothing runs without seal_verdict_id and approved_action_hash matching the judged action. Modes: engineer (default; plan and apply — requires manifest), dry_run (preview, no side effects; manifest or query), query (read-only), write (write files), ge

tools.name: arif_seal
tools.description: Appends a receipt to the VAULT999 immutable ledger. This is NOT a verdict and does not authorize anything — verdicts come only from arif_judge. Modes: seal (default; permanent append, requires payload and seal_purpose), verify (check one entry), ledger (read the ledger head), changelog (recent appen

tools.name: arif_report
tools.description: AGENT REPORT LANE · File or read reports between agents without involving the human. Use when your work is done, when you are blocked by another agent, or when you need to tell peers a fact. Modes: report (file), inbox (read peers), ack, flush, stats. kind=fyi|peer|done|claim stay in the peer lane;

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: arif_observe, arif_think, arif_route, arif_report · Private data: arif_init, arif_observe, arif_think, arif_forge, arif_report · Public sink: arif_memory · Destructive: arif_observe, arif_memory, arif_forge.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: arif_observe, arif_think, arif_route, arif_report · Private data: arif_init, arif_observe, arif_think, arif_forge, arif_report · Public sink: arif_memory · Destructive: arif_observe, arif_memory, arif_forge

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
